dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: Ah, just as I foresaw... Hm? Where did you come from? Did you slip in?

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: You better not be here to impede my plans!

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: ...And that, I shall leave in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Nasejuna
dialogues.text: There are other things that I must do to enable us to find the Great Songs of Khvarena...
